gate.sub: Your shipment is priced and ready. We ask for an account before showing carrier rates so your quotes are saved and bookable.
gate.benefitRates: See all 6 carrier rates with the full cost breakdown
gate.benefitSaved: Quotes saved and valid for 48 hours
gate.benefitBook: Book in one click and track the shipment

dashboard.emptyBody: Price a shipment and your quotes, bookings, savings and spend all appear here.
dashboard.saveTipBody: Shipping the same lane twice a month? FCL beats LTL on cost above 8 m³ — the wizard flags it for you at the mode step.

wizard.title: Freight Rate Calculator
wizard.sub: Answer five short steps and we price your shipment across every carrier on the lane.
wizard.s2Title: How do you want to ship?
wizard.s2Sub: Select the transport mode that fits your timeline and budget.
wizard.s3Sub: Pick the closest match — we set the freight class from it and your measured density.
wizard.classNote: Freight class is what carriers actually bill against. You never have to look it up: we derive it from your cargo type and the density we calculate in the next step.
wizard.cargoFurnitureHint: Bulky and light — volume drives price
wizard.s4Sub: Enter the total shipment measurements for accurate rate calculation.
wizard.cargoDescPh: Brief description of goods, any special handling requirements…
wizard.readyBody: We’ll query 6 carriers simultaneously. A free account is needed to see the rates and book — it takes one step.

results.benchSaveUpTo: avg. market rate · save up to {amount}
results.noQuotesTitle: No carrier covers that mode on this lane
results.noQuotesBody: None of the six seeded carriers priced this shipment as the mode you picked. Switch back to all modes to see every option we found.
results.seedNote: Rates come from a seeded market dataset for this MVP, not a live carrier API. Every quote is indicative and valid for 48 hours.

booking.confirmSub: Review your selection and confirm contact details.
booking.specialPh: Any special handling, delivery instructions, or notes for the carrier…
booking.finePrint: By confirming, you agree to the carrier’s terms of service. You may cancel within 24 hours for a full refund.

confirmed.title: Booking confirmed.
confirmed.sub: The carrier has your shipment. Track status and export the record from My Cabinet — no email chain needed.
confirmed.settleNote: Payment is arranged directly with the carrier against their invoice. In-app settlement is not part of this release.

cabinet.title: My Cabinet
cabinet.sub: Quote history, shipment tracking and cost exports.

cabinet.csvNote: CSV export includes quote ID, origin, destination, mode, carrier, status, all-in cost, market benchmark and saving for every row — the format your accountant asks for.
cabinet.emptyBody: Every quote you run and every shipment you book is kept here, with a CSV export your accountant can open.
cabinet.emptyTabQuotes: Every quote you ran has been booked
